report:
Liver, biopsy

Sections show a core of liver measuring 12 mm in length. The core contains a limited focus of atypical cells, suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma. On immunohistochemistry, the atypical cells are focally positive for glypican-3. Glutamine synthetase shows diffuse strong staining. The reticulin framework is focally reduced. No non-lesional liver is present.

LIVER, biopsy - Suspicious for HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA
